correctness.rationale: For three colours on complete bipartite Kmn at least one shore is monochromatic, so inclusion-exclusion of two monochromatic-shore classes and the overlap gives W=3[(-1)^(m-a)2^a+(-1)^(n-b)2^b+1-3*[A=0]] on A+B=0, and vanishes otherwise. Solving the signed powers of two equal to -1 (A nonzero) or 2 (A=0) yields exactly five (a,b,A) classes, possible only in even-even sizes. The roots-of-unity filter U_r,V_r gives precise E_mn; Fourier diagonalization gives rank 3^(m+n-1)-E. The minimal support follows from a+b max and U_1=0 at (2,2). Independent integer cyclotomic triple-count enumeration for (1,1),(1,2),(2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(3,3),(4,4) checked EVERY Fourier multiplier and the exact ranks, including the 2x2 boundary.
